how-i-work.eyebrow: Micro-label for process section (e.g., 'How I work'). Max 3 words.
how-i-work.h2: Heading describing delivery workflow (e.g., 'How I deliver a machine learning project'). Max 8 words.
how-i-work.lede: Lede paragraph describing milestone-based delivery and regular updates. Exactly 1 sentence.

tl-when.pill: Step stage or day range (e.g., 'Day 1 to 2', 'Step 02').
tl-when.sub: Stage subtitle / timing tag (e.g., 'free call', 'within 48h', 'the build').

tl-body.h3: Milestone step title (e.g., 'Discovery', 'Scope and technical spec'). Max 4 words.
tl-body.p: Description of actions, deliverables, and communication during this step. Must reference {{CITY}} in discovery call step. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

btn--primary.text: CTA button text (e.g., 'Start with a free discovery call').

proof-section.eyebrow: Micro-label for case studies (e.g., 'Proof'). Max 2 words.
proof-section.h2: Heading introducing delivered projects with numbers (e.g., 'Machine learning projects delivered, with real numbers'). Max 8 words.
proof-section.lede: Lede paragraph explaining verifiable case studies with measurable outcomes. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

proof-card.proof-cat: Domain category tag (e.g., 'NLP', 'Computer Vision', 'Predictive Modeling'). Max 2 words.

proof-inner.h3: Case study title describing technical solution (e.g., 'NLP for chatbots'). Max 5 words.
proof-inner.p: Description of problem solved and business impact. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

proof-metric.b: Key metric percentage or speedup number (e.g., '92%', '95%', '<60s').

btn--ghost.text: Button text to view all case studies (e.g., 'View all 12 case studies').

why-me.eyebrow: Micro-label for differentiators (e.g., 'Why me'). Max 2 words.
why-me.h2: Heading asking why local businesses choose the specialist (e.g., 'Why {{CITY}} businesses choose to work with me'). Must include {{CITY}}.

why-card.h3: Differentiator title (e.g., 'Local presence, global standard'). Max 4-5 words.
why-card.p: Description explaining why this benefit matters to businesses in {{CITY}}. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

center.eyebrow: Micro-label for testimonials (e.g., 'Client words'). Max 2 words.
center.h2: Heading introducing verified client feedback (e.g., 'What clients say about working directly with me'). Max 8 words.
center.lede: Lede paragraph explaining client reviews. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

tst-card.tst-quote: Direct quote from a client praising direct access, technical execution, and reliability. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

insights.eyebrow: Micro-label for blog/guides section (e.g., 'Insights'). Max 2 words.
insights.h2: Heading introducing guides before hiring (e.g., 'Reading before you hire an ML engineer'). Max 7 words.
insights.lede: Lede paragraph describing technical articles on cost and strategy. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

blog-inner.h3: Article title covering hiring advice or pricing breakdown (e.g., 'Machine learning consultant cost in 2026, by project type'). Max 8 words.

btn--ghost.text: Link button to full blog (e.g., 'Read the blog').

center.eyebrow: Micro-label for FAQ section (e.g., 'FAQ'). Max 1 word.
center.h2: Heading for FAQ (e.g., 'Frequently asked questions'). Max 3 words.
center.lede: Lede paragraph for FAQ section. Must include {{CITY}}. Exactly 1 sentence.

faq-item.faq-q: Question addressing client objection, pricing, process, or local availability in {{CITY}}. Must include {{CITY}} where relevant.
faq-item.faq-a: Clear, reassuring answer providing direct information without fluff. Must include {{CITY}} and {{STATE}} where relevant. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

call-me-now.eyebrow: Micro-label above primary contact CTA (e.g., 'Call me now'). Max 3 words.
call-me-now.h2: Heading inviting project discussion (e.g., 'Talk to a machine learning engineer in {{CITY}}'). Must include {{CITY}}.
call-me-now.lede: Lede paragraph explaining response time (24h) and spec delivery (48h). Exactly 2 sentences.

btn--wa.text: WhatsApp contact button text with phone number (e.g., 'WhatsApp +91 95372 90206').

call-me-now.cta-meta: Metadata string detailing response time, spec timeframe, and NDA policy. Max 10 words.

author-row.span: Specialist title and location (e.g., 'Machine Learning Engineer · {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}').
